evidence.note: Both SOIC-16 300mil for the JVSIQ / 73F suffix.
Standard SPI flash pinout matches for CS#/CLK/IO0-IO3/VCC/GND on SOIC-16, but WP#/HOLD#/RESET# pin positions and active polarity differ between Winbond and Macronix families.
Both support standard SPI + Dual + Quad commands. Erase block sizes (4 KB / 32 KB / 64 KB) overlap but command opcodes for 4-byte addressing and QPI mode differ.

conditions: WP#/HOLD# routing on the board must tolerate the pinout difference (typically WP#=pin 3, HOLD#=pin 7 on Winbond; verify against the Macronix datasheet for the chosen density).
BIOS image must be reprogrammed for the new chip's command set (especially 4KB erase opcode and QPI entry sequence).
Boot ROM must not depend on Winbond-specific security registers or unique IDs.
verification_notes: Cross-vendor BIOS flash swaps are common practice but conditional on the WP/HOLD pinout and on reprogramming the BIOS image. Never assume bit-for-bit compatibility without reflashing.
